pr_title: [listproviders][video][PVR][utils][builtins] Fix and Refactor Video Select Actions
pr_body:
Fixes #23722

Well, I only wanted to quickly fix a bug and it ended with a larger refactoring of the video select action handling code across the code base. I think the code is now in a much better maintainable shape than it was before.

Runtime-tested on macOS and Android, latest Kodi master.

@enen92 maybe you could have a look at the code changes? I tried to split stuff into logical chunks, so best to review commit by commit.
pr_comments: @enen92 requested changes are incorporated now. Good to go in?

Side note: Video default select action handling for Favorites (Home screen Favorites widget, Favorites window, (deprecated Favorites dialog) is still pending. This will be a bit more work and might come with a follow-up PR.

Hi, thanks for the great work first of all!
On omega beta 3 (and 2) on android (fire cube) the default select action does not seem to work for TV shows. For movies it works fine, but for tv shows if set to "show information" or "choose" it just goes into the "seasons" view directly as if "play" were the default action. If I open the context menu with the c key, with the cursor on the tv show and select "information", only then it does show the information screen. This happens on both library tv shows and addon tv shows. Am I misunderstanding something? Thanks again!

> but for tv shows if set to "show information" or "choose" it just goes into the "seasons" view directly

Works as designed and imo never behaved differently. Default select action setting applies only to media (movies, episodes), not folders (tv shows, seasons. movie sets).

Yes, sorry you are right, I just reverted to a clean nexus install and it works like you say. In my previous nexus setup I somehow had it so that when clicking on a tv show (mostly in an addon home screen widget), it showed the information screen and only after clicking again did it go to seasons view. I have no idea how to replicate this functionality now on either omega or a clean nexus install, so maybe it was a bug or something, but I liked it... Anyway, sorry for the confusion.

Movie or music video plays or present resume dialog but no option to show information.

comments:
> Click on a music video widget or movie widget

What exactly do you mean with "widget"?
Home screen widget. Actually did not test the library views.
The library views are fine. It is the Home screen widgets that have the problem

> As a comparison, episodes gives either Play/Show Info or Resume/Beginning/Show info when selected

I don't think so and cannot reproduce this. Episodes behave as movies and music videos and do also NOT respect the setting value.

Side note: Video default select action handling for Estuary Home screen Favorites widget, Favorites window, (deprecated Favorites dialog) is still pending. This will be a bit more work and might come with a follow-up PR.

review_comments: I think this is likely a getdynpath here. I.e. a plugin:// item could resolve to a Pvr recording right? In such cases behaviour would differ if playing the plugin item or the Pvr recording directly

Nope. I need to check the pvr-URL, which is the unchangable identity of the item.

> plugin:// item could resolve to a Pvr recording right

Those cases currently will not work as by design. Dyn path is just a single de-reference, what you are referring to would need a chain of path to work: plugin -> pvr -> file
